changeSet.author: FStavcev
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chats ( id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY ,title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL ,type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL ,last_message VARCHAR(1000) ,last_message_time TIMESTAMP );

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS chats CASCADE;

changeSet.author: FStavcev
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_participants ( chat_id BIGINT NOT NULL ,user_id BIGINT NOT NULL ,PRIMARY KEY (chat_id, user_id) ,CONSTRAINT fk_chat_participants_chat FOREIGN KEY (chat_id) REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ,CONSTRAINT fk_chat_participants_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE );

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS chat_participants CASCADE;

changeSet.author: FStavcev
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages ( id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY ,chat_id BIGINT NOT NULL ,sender_id BIGINT NOT NULL ,content TEXT ,created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ,is_read BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE ,CONSTRAINT fk_messages_chat FOREIGN KEY (chat_id) REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ,CONSTRAINT fk_messages_sender FOREIGN KEY (sender_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE );

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS messages CASCADE;
